summary: Every fallback below has been executed against a running server with the upstream it protects against genuinely broken.

results.title: The intel heatmap keeps its tiles when pump.fun throttles
results.why: pump.fun answers a burst with 429 far more often than it goes down, and the board is the whole page. The retry honours Retry-After and the last-good tier carries the tiles through what is left, so a throttle costs freshness rather than the page.

results.title: A coin page still renders when CoinGecko is rate limiting
results.why: CoinGecko's keyless tier is shared per egress IP and throttles on its own schedule, which is why /coin/:id 502'd for hours on 2026-07-28. CoinPaprika supplies the profile and DefiLlama the price series, so a throttle costs the page its primary source and nothing else.

results.title: Holder concentration survives a Solana RPC lane refusing
results.why: Every lane in the rotation throttles at some point, and free lanes refuse specific call shapes outright. The rotation walks them, demotes a lane per method rather than benching it wholesale, and answers an idempotent read from its last-good body when the whole chain is down.

results.title: A token page still resolves when DexScreener is throttling
results.why: One keyless read used to decide whether a token exists at all, so a throttle made a live token read as not found. It now retries behind a breaker with a last-known-good payload, and a definitive miss is reserved for cases where a source actually spoke.
